claims: Parallel sunlight, vertical objects and level ground produce right triangles with a shared sun angle. Similarity gives H/h = S/s. A one-metre stick casting a two-metre shadow implies a five-metre tree when its shadow is ten metres long.
Separate side-view panels share the scale and angle. Foliage stays below the measured highest point. Slope and changing sun angles between measurements are excluded.
limitations: Numerical checks complement the stated derivation; idealizations are explicit.
